python -c "
import parse

# Test R9: Left/center alignment should stop at space
p = parse.Parser('{:<}')
print('Left align pattern:', p._expression)
result = p.search('hello world')
print('Search \"hello world\" with {:<}:', result)
if result:
    print('  Value:', result[0])

p2 = parse.Parser('{:^}')
print('Center align pattern:', p2._expression)
result2 = p2.search('hello world')
print('Search \"hello world\" with {:^}:', result2)
if result2:
    print('  Value:', result2[0])

# Right alignment should still work as before
p3 = parse.Parser('{:>}')
print('Right align pattern:', p3._expression)
result3 = p3.search('hello world')
print('Search \"hello world\" with {:>}:', result3)
if result3:
    print('  Value:', result3[0])
" 2>/dev/null
